1. (Currently amended) A __computer-implemented__ method comprising: determining __by a processor__ that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing __by the processor__ a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving __by the processor__ an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting __by the processor__ the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life __via an electronic monetary transfer to an account owned by the recipient__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing __step__.

3. (Previously presented) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

4. (Previously presented) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

5. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction __for which a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction__.

7. (Cancelled)

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Cancelled)

10. (Currently amended) A __computer-implemented__ method comprising: determining __by a processor__ that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing, __by the processor,__ at a first point in time, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; determining __by the processor__ that the data store contains an indication that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication most recently with respect to one of said payment transactions at a second point in time earlier than the first point in time; comparing __by the processor__ a time interval defined by the second and first points in time with a pre-determined permissive time interval; making the benefit payment, without requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time does not exceed the pre-determined permissive time interval; and requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, prior to making the benefit payment, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time exceeds the pre-determined permissive time interval.

11. (Previously presented) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is seven days.

12. (Previously presented) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is 24 hours.

13. (Previously presented) The method of claim 10, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus comprising: a processor; and a memory in communication with the processor, the memory storing program instructions, the processor operative with the program instructions to perform functions as follows: determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life __via an electronic monetary transfer to an account owned by the recipient__.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing __of the data store__.

16. (Previously presented) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

17. (Previously presented) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

18. (Previously presented) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment.

19. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction __for which a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction__.

20. (Cancelled)
